name: Smash 'N Grab
detailed_description:
Smash ‘N Grab is an adrenaline-fuelled, destructive beat ’em up that puts you in control of Smash and Grab, a chaotic duo pulling off heists to devastating effect. Smash is a hulking robot out for justice. Grab is a cunning raccoon chasing wealth. Tethered by a rope, Smash can launch Grab to reel enemies in, seize valuables, and grapple through the environment. Together, they team up to loot everything in sight!

Pull off the perfect heist.
Your goal in each level is simple: steal all the prized possessions and make your escape. The faster you pull it off, the higher your score. Smash through walls, tear through furniture, and uncover hidden loot as you carve the most efficient—and most destructive—route through every environment.

Smash hard. Grab fast.
Time is everything. Earn precious seconds by destroying valuables, defeating guards, and looting every last corner. Use your stolen diamonds to purchase upgrades and equipment that enhance your abilities and open up new strategies for theft and takedowns.

Dismantle the mob.
Face off against a growing roster of guard types hired by the city's criminal underworld. Outsmart them, outmaneuver them, and bring chaos to their empire, one shattered vault at a time. Rise through the ranks, defeat each mob boss, and help Smash get his revenge—while Grab lines his pockets.

Master the duo.
Smash and Grab are stronger together—use their unique abilities in tandem to take down enemies, solve traversal challenges, and steal loot in ever more inventive ways. As you progress, unlock new moves and ways to wreak havoc with your tethered partners-in-crime.

A noir world with punch.
Step into a stylized, noir-inspired world brought to life with striking, bold visuals. Your actions drive a dynamic jazz-orchestral soundtrack that rises and falls with the pace of your heist, delivering a rhythm-infused experience that hits as hard as Smash himself.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
